LESSON: INTER- DEPENDENCE OF PEOPLE

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: People and Population
Topic 2.1: Inter- dependence of people
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Inter- dependence of people, part of People and Population in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: How do people in the county depend on each other? 2. Why should we support each other in the county?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Inter- dependence of people together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Citizenship: Learners develop information and communication skills as they role play interdependence of people in the county.

● Learning to Learn: Learners carry out research/investigations as they find out from parents and guardians on importance of

interdependence of people and report back.

● Creativity and imagination: learners role play the interdependence of people in the county.

Values:
● Love: Learners portray a caring attitude as they work in groups to create a chart on benefits of interdependence among people.

● Social justice: Learners advocate for harmonious relationship as they discuss on importance of interdependence among people.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Assertiveness: Learners speaks clearly and airs views firmly as they brainstorm in class the ways in which people depend on each other in

the county.

● Social Cohesion: Learners respects others views/feelings as they work in groups to create a chart on benefits of interdependence among

people.

Links to other Learning Areas:
● Religious Education: learners explain the importance of interdependence.

● English, Kiswahili and KSL as learners develop communication skills as they recite a poem about the importance of interdependence of

people.

Suggested Learning Resources

Vetted digital devices with assistive technology, Manilla papers and Braille resources.
